title: Satori business app dependency
description: Has the package depend on another Marketplace package, in package/package.xml: an add-on whose facet, schema or operation the kit names.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

name.description: The Marketplace package it depends on, such as nuxeo-agentic-signature.
name.x-prompt: Which package does it depend on (e.g. nuxeo-agentic-signature)?

version.description: The version it needs at least, such as 0.1.0, or a range, 0.1.0:1.0.0. Not with remove.

remove.description: Take the dependency out. Never nuxeo-agentic-ui, the platform's own.
